notes.title: UE5.1
notes.content: Darkion is now using Unreal Engine version 5.1 which introduces many improvements in multiple aspects like performance, visual fidelity and more! however new bugs are expected to appear since engine updates introduce a lot of changes. Happy Testing!

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.content: Controllers as input devices now supported (In gameplay only for now)

notes.title: Massive lighting quality improvements!
notes.content: The Shaolin Temple looks greater than ever after this new update!

notes.title: Shaolin Temple map improvements
notes.content: added a bunch of lighting to dark areas and improved the visual appearance of the map.

notes.title: Optimization + Movement Improved
notes.content:
"Shaolin Temple" map has been optimized for better performance.

Character now moves smoother through non-flat terrain (rocky terrain like the Shaolin Temple Map)

notes.title: No more "test" accounts
notes.content:
Added Steam Authentication for account ownership.
Up until now we've used a small number of "demo" accounts and some accounts were actually shared between multiple users. Now every steam account has its own in-game account.

notes.title: "Immortal Attack" added
notes.content: Pressing both mouse 1 + mouse 2 buttons initiates an "Immortal Attack" turning your character invincible for a short period of time. Keep in mind that after the attack, your character is unable to move or attack for another short period of time. until he recovers, he is very vulnerable and enemies can take advantage of that.

notes.title: Vaulting system
notes.content: Introduced a new character vaulting system to vault over tall objects.

notes.title: Audio update + More
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Additional sounds have been added.
[*] Improvements to the Acoustics system.
[*] Changes to the green test map to better debug and test the new game audio. (It sounds amazing!)
[*] Viking jump animation fixed.
[*] Monk weapon socket adjusted on all primary weapons.
[/list]

notes.title: Viking fix
notes.content: Viking armor is now visible in the main menu.
